name: devcast-api-docs
description: TypeSpec definitions for the DevCast backend API, compiled to OpenAPI 3.1

scripts.build:html: mkdir -p dist && cp tsp-output/openapi/devcast-api.yaml dist/openapi.yaml && redocly build-docs dist/openapi.yaml -o dist/index.html
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:html
